title: Chè Chuối: Warm Banana, Tapioca and Coconut Milk Dessert
summary: A warm, fragrant pudding of soft bananas and tender tapioca pearls in sweetened coconut milk, finished with crushed peanuts.

ingredients.item: pandan leaves, tied in a knot (or 0.5 tsp vanilla)
ripe bananas (pisang awak if you can find them), peeled and cut on the diagonal into 2.5 cm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Combine 600 ml water, 200 ml of the coconut milk and the knotted pandan leaves in a saucepan and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add 55 g tapioca pearls, lower to a simmer and cook, stirring often, about 10 min until translucent.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Stir in 450 g banana pieces and simmer about 5 min until soft and bright yellow in the centre.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the remaining 200 ml coconut milk, 3 tbsp sugar and ⅛ tsp salt, bring back to a gentle boil, then remove the pandan and adjust the sugar to taste.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls and top with 50 g crushed roasted peanuts.

tips: Stir the tapioca often as it cooks so the pearls stay separate rather than clumping together.
Add the second half of the coconut milk only once the bananas are soft, to keep its flavour fresh.
Taste before serving and add a little extra sugar if the bananas aren't very sweet.
storage: Best served fresh while warm; keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days and reheat gently on the stove, loosening with a little water if needed.
